parts.name: Exhaust Pipe Assembly (#1)
parts.description: One assembly made of two header pipes, one per cylinder, that run down the front of the engine and turn rearward underneath it. There they merge into a large box-shaped chamber, and a single outlet pipe leaves the chamber toward the muffler on the right side. The 3D shape follows the layout in the 2026 diagram but is simplified.
parts.function: Carries exhaust gas from both exhaust ports, combines the two flows in the under-engine chamber and feeds them to the muffler. A wired sensor (#14) is fitted to the pipe; what the chamber contains (for example a catalytic converter) is not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.
parts.verificationNote: Layout read from the 2026 CMX500AAC MUFFLER diagram. Honda's part name and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

oem.note: Diagram item #1. Honda groups the exhaust pipe in the MUFFLER diagram.

parts.name: Exhaust Sensor (#14)
parts.description: A sensor screwed into the exhaust pipe, with a wire lead and connector (diagram #14, held by clips). Its exact position on the pipe in the 3D view is approximate.
parts.function: Probably an oxygen (O₂) sensor: on fuel-injected engines it measures oxygen left in the exhaust so the engine-control unit can fine-tune the fuel mixture. That identification comes from the part's appearance in the diagram, not from Honda's parts list.
parts.verificationNote: Seen in the 2026 MUFFLER diagram. Sensor type, Honda name and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Muffler (#5)
parts.description: A long muffler on the right side. It tapers from a narrow inlet at the front to a large body at the rear and bolts to the frame through a bracket on top with rubber mounts. Honda calls it a 'specially designed muffler' that 'emits a pulsating exhaust note.'
parts.function: Reduces exhaust noise to legal levels and shapes the exhaust sound. Honda notes California models may differ due to emissions equipment.

oem.note: Diagram item #5. The part number is not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Muffler Side Cover (#7)
parts.description: A separate tapered cover that screws onto the outer side of the muffler (diagram #7, with its screws).
parts.function: Appears to act as a styling cover and heat guard over the outer face of the muffler. Honda's name for it is not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Gaskets & Pipe Joint (#3, #8, #9)
parts.description: Two ring gaskets where the header pipes seal against the cylinder head (#3), and a clamp band (#8) with a gasket (#9) where the exhaust pipe slips into the muffler.
parts.function: Seal the exhaust against leaks. Header gaskets are normally replaced whenever the pipes are removed.
parts.verificationNote: Honda names, part numbers and torque values are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

service.notes: Exhaust joint and stud nut torques not yet verified. Consult the Honda service manual (61MLH00).

parts.name: Exhaust Mounting Hardware
parts.description: Brackets, rubber mounts and collars, bolts, nuts (including the stud nuts at the cylinder head, #19), washers and wire clips (about #2, #4, #6, #10–#13 and #15–#25 in the diagram).
parts.function: Hold the exhaust to the engine and frame. The rubber mounts isolate vibration, and the clips route the sensor wire.
parts.verificationNote: Individual items, names and torque values are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

service.notes: Torque specification not yet verified. Consult the Honda service manual (61MLH00).
